title: Wetland Mapping Using Remote Sensing
shortDescription: A remote sensing project focused on identifying and mapping wetland areas using multispectral imagery, NDWI, supervised classification, and LiDAR-derived information.
description: This project focused on identifying and mapping wetland areas using multispectral imagery and LiDAR-derived information. Remote sensing and GIS techniques were used to analyze vegetation, water, and wetland characteristics.
overview: The objective of this project was to identify and map wetland areas using remote sensing imagery and LiDAR data. The analysis combined spectral information with spatial analysis techniques to produce a detailed wetland map.
objectives: Use NDWI to identify water and wet areas.
Evaluate the accuracy of the classification.

methodology.title: Data Preparation
methodology.description: Prepared multispectral imagery, LiDAR data, and supporting GIS datasets for analysis.

methodology.title: NDWI Analysis
methodology.description: Calculated the Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) to identify water and wet areas.

methodology.title: Image Classification
methodology.description: Performed supervised classification to separate wetland, vegetation, water, and other land-cover classes.

methodology.title: Accuracy Assessment
methodology.description: Evaluated the classification results using validation points and accuracy statistics.

results.label: Analysis
results.value: Wetland areas successfully identified and mapped

title: Calgary Rooftop Solar Potential
shortDescription: A GIS analysis that evaluates rooftop solar potential in Calgary using solar radiation, building footprints, elevation data, and neighbourhood-level information.
description: This project evaluates rooftop solar potential across Calgary by combining solar radiation data, building footprints, elevation data, and neighbourhood-level information.
overview: The goal of this project was to estimate rooftop solar potential across Calgary and identify neighbourhoods with greater potential for solar energy generation.

methodology.title: Data Preparation
methodology.description: Prepared building footprints, elevation data, solar radiation rasters, and neighbourhood boundaries.

methodology.title: Solar Radiation Analysis
methodology.description: Analyzed solar radiation values across the study area.

methodology.title: Building Analysis
methodology.description: Used building footprints and zonal statistics to summarize solar radiation for individual buildings.

methodology.title: Neighbourhood Analysis
methodology.description: Aggregated results by neighbourhood to compare rooftop solar potential.

title: Urban Tree Canopy Analysis
shortDescription: An urban GIS analysis examining tree canopy coverage across Calgary neighbourhoods and calculating canopy area to support better understanding of urban vegetation.
description: This project examined urban tree canopy coverage across Calgary neighbourhoods using GIS and spatial analysis techniques.
overview: The project analyzed tree canopy distribution across Calgary neighbourhoods to better understand urban vegetation patterns.
objectives: Visualize the results using Web GIS.

methodology.title: Data Preparation
methodology.description: Prepared tree canopy and neighbourhood boundary datasets.

methodology.title: Spatial Analysis
methodology.description: Performed spatial analysis to determine tree canopy coverage.

methodology.title: Area Calculation
methodology.description: Calculated tree canopy area for each neighbourhood.

methodology.title: Web Mapping
methodology.description: Published and visualized the results using ArcGIS Online.

title: Assault Data Analysis & Dashboard
shortDescription: An interactive GIS application analyzing January 2024 assault incidents using neighbourhood boundaries, density analysis, custom geoprocessing tools, and web mapping.
description: This project analyzes January 2024 assault incidents using GIS, spatial analysis, ModelBuilder, ArcGIS Online, and Experience Builder.
overview: The project was developed as an interactive web GIS application for exploring assault incidents in January 2024. It combines spatial analysis, density mapping, custom geoprocessing tools, dashboards, and web mapping.
objectives: Develop an interactive web GIS application.

methodology.title: Data Preparation
methodology.description: Prepared the January 2024 assault incident dataset and neighbourhood boundaries.

methodology.title: Density Analysis
methodology.description: Analyzed the spatial distribution and density of assault incidents.

methodology.title: Custom Tool
methodology.description: Developed a ModelBuilder tool to summarize assault incidents by assault type.

methodology.title: Web GIS
methodology.description: Published the GIS layers and custom tool to ArcGIS Online and integrated them into Experience Builder.
